items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability leading to privilege escalation and customer account takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to switch a customer session to another customer account, leading to privilege escalation and potential access to private customer data. Exploitation attempts have been detected in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation. This bulletin encompasses multiple CVEs.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Auth Bypass) vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw (CVSS 7.5) allowing a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the affected application.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving a critical vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution vulnerability
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-42, could lead to arbitrary code execution in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API that lets unauthenticated attackers upload executable files to any store by disguising code as an image. Sansec has observed widespread exploitation attempts.
